exclusion_reason: The frame-diff engine is implemented with a test-time reference generator, a weighted delta-E comparison, a declared tolerance, and an explicit committed_baseline false; the suite proves a rendering mutation is caught. The benchmark remains red because no rendered frame exists until the live backend renders.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the frame diff computes its reference at test time, distinguishes the declared metric set, and retains no committed baseline.
expected_failing_assertion: No rendered frame or frame comparison exists.
active_gate_evidence: The shader suite computes the reference at test time, passes a small drift, fails a rendering mutation, refuses a length mismatch, and records committed_baseline false.
procedure: Render the fixture and compute the reference at test time from the declared generator.
Compare with the declared metric set and threshold metadata.
Assert no baseline artifact is committed or retained.
pass_criterion: Known rendering mutation is caught by the metric set.
